output.summary: Jai is the sole approver of customer responses and checks answers with their owning teams. There is no central record of what has been sent to each customer. The notes indicate that new customers need recent security-testing evidence.

claims.value: Jai approves every customer response; he is the sole approver

claims.speaker: Jai

claims.value: Jai checks answers with the team that owns them
